turns.question: What was our revenue in Q3 2026?
turns.answer: "Q3 2026" could mean calendar Q3 or the fiscal Q3 (fiscal year starts 1 February), so here are both. Revenue (EUR) for calendar Q3, 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30, was 17,656.25 EUR; for fiscal Q3, 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-31, it was 19,793.59 EUR. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
